ozz-animation 0.17.0
https://github.com/guillaumeblanc/ozz-animation (tag 0.17.0)

Library sources only. Dropped: extern/ (glfw, gtest, jsoncpp), media/,
samples/, howtos/, test/, and src/animation/offline/{tools,fbx,gltf} - all of
them serve the *2ozz command line tools, samples and tests, which are off.
Skeletons and animations are built in-process from assimp data through the
offline Raw* types and builders instead, so no importer tool is needed.

Patches:
- src/animation/offline/CMakeLists.txt: no add_subdirectory of tools/fbx/gltf.
- build-utils/cmake/compiler_settings.cmake: does not add /W4 on MSVC.
